segments.line: Hey, can I borrow two hundred? Just till Friday. (then Ama's silent panicked smile)
That's the third time this month. And that 'Friday'? It never comes.
If your gut screams no, but your mouth says yes... you're suffering from the People-Pleaser Tax.
Stop answering on the spot. Panic makes you a yes-man. Your first move is to pause.
Let me check my week and get back to you.
Next, separate the person from the favor. You aren't rejecting them; you're declining the task.
I can't lend money right now... but I can help you build a budget this weekend. (cricket)
No lies. No drama. Just a clear boundary. The two hundred stays in your pocket.
A kind no beats a broke yes. Every time.
